steps.caption: Locations
steps.narration: This is Locations: every Google Business Profile you manage, in one list.

steps.caption: Search, filter, scroll
steps.narration: Search the list, filter it by client or status, and scroll to the listing you want.

steps.caption: Rating, reviews, category, hours
steps.narration: Each row shows the rating, the review count, the category, the hours and the latest review.

steps.caption: Call, Directions, Website, Reviews
steps.narration: Call, Directions, Website and Reviews open the listing's own links.

steps.caption: Opens on Insights
steps.narration: The location opens on Insights, the performance report Google shares for it.

steps.caption: Eight tabs
steps.narration: Eight tabs run down the side, from Insights to Citations.

steps.caption: Location Info
steps.narration: Location Info is the profile as Google has it: name, address, phone, website and hours.

steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Settings keeps a notification email for this location.

steps.caption: Delete removes the copy only
steps.narration: Delete removes ConstructHUB's copy only. Your Google listing is not affected.

steps.caption: Back to All locations
steps.narration: All locations takes you back to the list.

steps.caption: Google connection
steps.narration: At the bottom, Google connection lists the connected Google accounts.

steps.caption: Synced, ready to link, reconnect
steps.narration: This line counts the listings synced, ready to link, and needing a reconnect.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: You'll find Locations in the Google Business menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to work from the Locations page | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A tour of the Locations page in ConstructHUB: every Google Business Profile you manage in one list, each row with its rating, category, hours and quick links. Open a location for its eight tabs, from Insights to Citations, and find the connected Google accounts at the bottom of the page.
